findings.evidence: `mem_cone_iff` at lines 63/121 and `cone_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex` at line 112 characterize cones; `mem_join_iff` at Join.lean lines 80/147 and `join_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex` at line 137 characterize joins, so no consumer-facing unfolding need is shown.
findings.fix: Keep all four declarations `public` but remove `@[expose]`; prove internal `rfl`-based API lemmas with `:= (rfl)` or ordinary proofs so consumers use `mem_*_iff` and `*_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex`.
findings.issue: Both `PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.cone` (line 53) and `AbstractSimplicialComplex.cone` (line 103), plus both `join` definitions in `Join.lean` (lines 52 and 123), are marked `@[expose]`, making downstream code depend on implementation-level definitional equality.

summary: The new public operations unnecessarily expose their implementation bodies despite having characteristic membership and forgetful lemmas.
